name: Validate and deploy default Pages origin

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: pages-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Check out pinned indexer source
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          repository: pkgre/pkgre
          ref: 066293df21743cbf41fb571a38f2bb94059e7274
          fetch-depth: 0
          path: .verification/pkgre
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install Nix
        uses: cachix/install-nix-action@13d8dd58da0234aa297dedd986986ccb8e7f3e24 # v31
      - name: Build and validate inert site
        run: ./scripts/test-site.sh
      - name: Validate dormant bootstrap
        run: ./scripts/check-bootstrap.sh "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.verification/pkgre"
      - name: Require source tree stability
        run: git diff --exit-code
      - name: Configure GitHub Pages
        if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        uses: actions/configure-pages@983d7736d9b0ae728b81ab479565c72886d7745b # v5
      - name: Archive Pages artifact
        if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        run: |
          tar \
            --dereference --hard-dereference \
            --directory _site \
            -cvf "$RUNNER_TEMP/artifact.tar" \
            .
      - name: Upload Pages artifact
        if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: github-pages
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/artifact.tar
          retention-days: 1
          if-no-files-found: error

  deploy:
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    needs: validate
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      pages: write
      id-token: write
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    steps:
      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@d6db90164ac5ed86f2b6aed7e0febac5b3c0c03e # v4

name: CI

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  check-architecture:
    name: check (${{ matrix.architecture }})
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - architecture: x86_64-linux
            runner: ubuntu-24.04
          - architecture: aarch64-linux
            runner: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install Nix
        uses: cachix/install-nix-action@13d8dd58da0234aa297dedd986986ccb8e7f3e24 # v31
      - name: Run reproducible checks
        run: nix flake check --print-build-logs
  check:
    needs: check-architecture
    if: ${{ always() }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Require every architecture
        env:
          RESULT: ${{ needs.check-architecture.result }}
        run: test "$RESULT" = success

name: Validate and deploy registries

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: pages-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - name: Check out registry catalog
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Check out pinned indexer
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          repository: pkgre/pkgre
          ref: ae1dfbfd4e965dffb538e356f005e4fbb32fdb77
          path: tooling
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install Nix
        uses: cachix/install-nix-action@13d8dd58da0234aa297dedd986986ccb8e7f3e24 # v31
      - name: Build pinned indexer
        run: nix build --print-build-logs ./tooling#indexer
      - name: Require fully applied admissions
        run: ./result/bin/pkgre-indexer check registry
      - name: Require converged catalog
        run: |
          ./result/bin/pkgre-indexer lock registry
          changes="$(git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all -- registry)"
          if [[ -n "$changes" ]]; then
            printf '%s\n' "$changes" >&2
            echo "registry is not fully applied and converged; run pkgre-indexer update-apply or lock and commit every result" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
      - name: Render and reproduce site
        run: |
          ./result/bin/pkgre-indexer render registry site
          ./result/bin/pkgre-indexer verify registry site
      - name: Verify monotonic publication
        run: |
          mkdir previous
          curl --fail --silent --show-error --retry 3 https://rust.pkg.re/release.json --output previous/release.json
          curl --fail --silent --show-error --retry 3 https://rust.pkg.re/downloads.json --output previous/downloads.json
          ./result/bin/pkgre-indexer verify-monotonic previous site
      - name: Add landing page
        run: |
          if grep -Eiq "<(script|style)([[:space:]>])|[[:space:]](style|on[a-z]+)[[:space:]]*=|rel[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*[\"']?stylesheet" index.html; then
            echo "index.html must not contain CSS or JavaScript" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          install -m 0644 index.html site/index.html
      - name: Add origin health canary
        run: |
          expected='pkgre-origin rust v1'
          test "$(cat origin-health/v1.txt)" = "$expected"
          test "$(wc -c < origin-health/v1.txt)" -eq 21
          install -D -m 0644 origin-health/v1.txt site/origin-health/v1.txt
          cmp origin-health/v1.txt site/origin-health/v1.txt
      - name: Configure GitHub Pages
        if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        uses: actions/configure-pages@983d7736d9b0ae728b81ab479565c72886d7745b # v5
      - name: Archive Pages artifact
        if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        run: |
          tar \
            --dereference --hard-dereference \
            --directory site \
            -cvf "$RUNNER_TEMP/artifact.tar" \
            --exclude=.git \
            --exclude=.github \
            .
      - name: Upload Pages artifact
        if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: github-pages
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/artifact.tar
          retention-days: 1
          if-no-files-found: error

  deploy:
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    needs: validate
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      pages: write
      id-token: write
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    steps:
      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@d6db90164ac5ed86f2b6aed7e0febac5b3c0c03e # v4
